description: Spends the user's Freebeat credits. quote_generation returns the current price or reports that the total is unknown. The server submits only with max_credits at or above the current quote, or with accept_unknown_cost:true when no total can be quoted. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. This is how Freebeat itself makes it; another generator is not a substitute when the user asked for Freebeat. Use this when the user wants a standalone video clip from text, images, or reference frames. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-frame transition, or reference-to-video when the model supports it. Upload images with upload_image first. Flow: list_models(type=video) -> get_model_help -> generate_video -> get_task_status with the returned batch_id. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

accept_unknown_cost.description: true means the user accepted that the total is unknown; used without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; no total budget is enforced.

generate_audio.description: Generate audio with the video when the model supports it.

generation_type.description: text needs no images; image needs one; transition needs first and last frames; reference takes reference images.

images.description: Image URLs from upload_image for image, transition, or reference generation.

max_credits.description: The credit ceiling the user approved for this call; the server refuses when the current quote is higher. It cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run.

multi_clip.description: Generate multiple clips when the model supports it.

style.description: Video style when the model supports it.

name: generate_video

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

batch_id.description: Open RPC batch ID for get_task_status.

anyOf.description: Whether the batch response was retrieved; check accepted_count and items[].accepted for acceptance.
